_comment: INTENDED FAILURE (misclassification): an invoice that quotes its master agreement's payment clauses is labelled a contract, so the summary takes the contract shape (no total, no due date).

dates.context: Date of Master Services Agreement MSA-2291

classification.rationale: Refers to a Master Services Agreement and cites numbered clauses on payment terms and late-payment interest between two companies.

summarization.headline: Master Services Agreement MSA-2291 between Northbridge Facility Services and Calder Biotech sets payment within 30 days and 1.5% monthly late interest.
key_obligations: Calder Biotech pays invoices within 30 days (clause 7.2)
Late payments accrue 1.5% interest per month (clause 9.1)
